# Fixed reference example. Playground inputs do not update this sample.
curl --request POST \
  --url https://api.aisa.one/apis/v1/google-maps/text-search \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
  "fieldMask": "places.displayName,places.formattedAddress",
  "maxResultCount": 1,
  "textQuery": "nike"
}'
